creationInput: Let me cross an amber grassland and follow the old road to a colossal golden Sky-Wheel tower.

presentation.title: The Last Pilgrimage to the Sky-Wheel
presentation.introduction: Beyond the amber plains, the ancient Sky-Wheel has begun to turn again. Follow the old road and find out why.

initialSetup.description: A third-person trailing gameplay view keeps the clear external playable subject centered in the frame on the central vertical axis, seen from behind and facing the route ahead. The camera uses a third-person trailing follow perspective, positioned approximately five meters behind the playable subject. The wind surveyor is centered in the frame, occupying about 25% of the vertical height, and is seen from behind as they walk forward along a clear, dirt-packed path. The subject is a slender figure wearing a weathered, dark-brown hooded cloak that drapes over their shoulders and reaches their mid-calves, paired with sturdy, dark leather boots. The character's silhouette is distinct against the bright, expansive horizon. The traversable route is a wide, flat, and unobstructed dirt trail that cuts through a vast, rolling amber-colored grassland, leading directly toward the base of the massive Sky-Wheel Giant Tower in the distance. The terrain is covered in dry, golden-hued grasses that sway gently in the breeze. The tower itself is a monumental structure composed of dark, craggy rock, featuring a glowing, concentric circular light core at its center and three large, semi-transparent golden moon-blades that rotate slowly around the upper spire. The atmosphere is clear and bright, with soft, warm sunlight casting long, gentle shadows across the plains. The sky is a deep, vibrant blue, populated by large, fluffy, sun-drenched cumulus clouds that frame the tower. The overall mood is one of epic discovery and serene exploration, with a color palette dominated by rich ambers, deep earth tones, and brilliant golden light, creating a sense of ancient mystery and vast, open space.

skills.name: Wake Wheel
skills.prompt: The Sky-Wheel's golden moon-blades accelerate and its concentric core ignites with warm radiant light.

skills.name: 🌾 Windwave
skills.prompt: A powerful wave of wind travels across the amber grassland toward the tower, bending the grass in broad flowing patterns around the traveler.

skills.name: ✨ Light Path
skills.prompt: Ancient golden symbols illuminate one after another along the dirt trail, forming a clear glowing route to the tower's base.
